lines.text: In this lesson, you will learn to tell the difference between repeating a set number of times and forever, and choose the right loop for a game.
The red “repeat forever” block keeps going until you press stop.
Things that never stop in a game: clouds floating, fish swimming, music playing.
Things that happen a few times: 3 jumps, 5 steps.
The kangaroo hops exactly 5 times. Use 🔁 with a number.
Exactly 5 — a number loop stops when it’s done.
Great work! Let’s remember what we learned.
Now build along, then try the challenges. You’ve got this!
